intro: CAVA Pita Crisps are a beloved crunchy topping that adds texture and flavor to any bowl or pita. These baked wheat pita crisps deliver 70 calories per serving and come included with your order at no extra charge. A staple on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings), these golden crisps transform ordinary Mediterranean bowls into satisfying meals with delightful crunch in every bite.
priceCalories: Pita Crisps are included with your order at no additional cost, making them an excellent value addition to any creation from the [full CAVA menu](/). At just 70 calories per serving, these crisps provide satisfying crunch without significantly impacting your meal totals. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete bowl or pita nutritional information including all toppings.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Pita Crisps apart is their perfect baked texture that stays crispy even when added to bowls with dressings and dips. Unlike fried alternatives, these wheat-based crisps offer clean flavor that complements rather than overpowers other ingredients. Their authentic Mediterranean preparation makes them a signature element on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings), loved by customers who appreciate texture contrast.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Pita Crisps contains 70 calories with 11g fat, 6g carbohydrates, and 1g protein. While higher in fat due to the baking process, they remain a moderate addition when building balanced bowls. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed allergen information, as these contain wheat and may not suit all dietary needs.
whatsInside: CAVA Pita Crisps are made from simple baked wheat pita bread, cut and crisped to golden perfection. The ingredient list is straightforward without artificial additives or complex preservatives. These crisps maintain the authentic taste of traditional Mediterranean pita while providing the satisfying crunch that makes them a popular choice across the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) and bowl combinations.
tasteLike: Pita Crisps deliver a light, wheaty flavor with subtle toasted notes and satisfying crunch. The baked preparation creates a crispy texture without greasiness, allowing the natural wheat taste to shine through. They add a pleasant nutty undertone that pairs beautifully with fresh vegetables, creamy dips, and flavorful dressings without competing for attention or overwhelming delicate Mediterranean flavors.
customize: Add Pita Crisps to any bowl, pita, or salad from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for instant texture upgrade. They work exceptionally well sprinkled over greens, mixed into grain bases, or used as dippers for spreads from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Request extra crisps or combine with multiple fresh toppings for personalized crunch levels.
pairsWell: Pita Crisps pair wonderfully with Shredded Romaine, Tomato + Onion, Persian Cucumber, and Sumac Cabbage Slaw for textural variety. They complement creamy options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus and tzatziki. The crisps also balance rich proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), creating satisfying contrast in every bite of your Mediterranean creation.
healthyChoice: At 70 calories, Pita Crisps offer a reasonable indulgence for texture-seekers building nutritious bowls. While they contain 11g fat from baking, they provide satisfying crunch that enhances meal enjoyment and satiety. For those monitoring sodium or carbs, these crisps offer moderate amounts. Note that they contain gluten, so they are not suitable for the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) options.
howToOrder: Order Pita Crisps by selecting them from the toppings section when building your bowl or pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). They come included at no charge, so add them freely to customize your meal. Simply tell the team member you would like pita crisps, or tap the option when ordering through the app or online ordering system.
vsAlternatives: Compared to other crunchy toppings, Pita Crisps offer authentic Mediterranean flavor versus standard croutons or tortilla strips. At 70 calories, they provide more substance than lighter vegetable toppings like Persian Cucumber at 15 calories, but less than protein-heavy additions. Their included price makes them more economical than purchasing sides separately from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides).
whoShouldTry: Pita Crisps are perfect for anyone who loves textural contrast in their Mediterranean bowls. Ideal for first-time visitors exploring the [full CAVA menu](/), these crisps add familiar crunch to new flavor combinations. They suit customers building lighter bowls who want satisfying elements without heavy proteins, and anyone who enjoys dipping and scooping with their meal components.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth adding to your CAVA order, especially since Pita Crisps come included at no extra charge. They elevate simple grain bowls into restaurant-quality meals with minimal calorie investment. The authentic baked flavor and reliable crunch make them a customer favorite that enhances nearly any combination from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) or custom creations you build yourself.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Pita Crisps?
faqs.a: CAVA Pita Crisps contain 70 calories per serving, with 11g fat, 6g carbohydrates, and 1g protein. They are included with your order at no additional charge and add satisfying crunch to any bowl or pita creation.

No, Pita Crisps are made from baked wheat pita bread and contain gluten. Customers seeking gluten-free options should explore other toppings on the CAVA Toppings Menu or visit the CAVA Gluten Free Menu for suitable alternatives.

faqs.q: Do Pita Crisps cost extra at CAVA?
faqs.a: No, Pita Crisps are included with your order at no additional cost. They are part of the complimentary toppings selection available when building your bowl, pita, or salad at CAVA restaurants.

faqs.q: What are CAVA Pita Crisps made from?
faqs.a: CAVA Pita Crisps are made from baked wheat pita bread that is cut and crisped to create a crunchy topping. The simple preparation highlights authentic Mediterranean flavors without artificial additives or complex ingredients.

faqs.q: Can I get extra Pita Crisps on my CAVA order?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request extra Pita Crisps when ordering at CAVA locations. Since they are included toppings, adding more is typically accommodated. Simply ask the team member building your bowl or pita for additional crisps.
